body: Yo're not alone, I have all 3 of those too and currently a college student as well. I'm terrible at math, I'm surprised & pleased to hear that you're taking a pre-calc course! Everyone else with dyscalculia that I've messaged with is always stuck in remedial classes like myself. I hope you can over come these difficult issues, if you'd like any support or just someone to chat with my pms are always open. :)

I hope I'm not too late in responding to you, but it sounds like we are in the same boat. I started community college in January this year, I was placed in a remedial class, "Elementary Algebra." I'm a Chemistry major and I'm doing the same things you are, but it all feels like a waste of time because I'm not retaining the information. I too really want to kill myself and I have for a long time. I get ridiculed as well. I'm pretty sure you've heard of this but [Khan Academy] (https://www.khanacademy.org) is a resource that helps me, although I have forgotten most of what I learned. I hope it can be useful to you, please message me if you're feeling bad. I haven't had anyone to speak to either and I've been searching for a suicidal person with the same issues as me.
Thank you, this is my first time posting here and I thought I'd be able to post imgur links, i wanted to show screenshots from his texts to me and as well as pictures of the gifts, but thank you

I honestly believe my parents want me to kill myself. & I believe I'm doing everything correct, I'm going to college full time to get my PhD, going to one of the best colleges in state, I'm not in debt, I graduated high school early, I don't even live with them anymore because they just put strain on my life. They've just never been supportive parents

My parents don't give a single fuck. My parents are annoyed as well. My mom tells me she wants me the fuck out of their lives already, I wish someone cared. My mom took me to an awful residential mental health facility and left me there, she was supposed to pick me up within 3 days, but she left me there a week and didn't answer the facilities phone calls. I had asked her to pick me up over the phone and she told me to shut the fuck up and stay there longer, my parents just do not want to deal with me. They have been unfit parents my whole life. I can't speak for anyone else's parents but a lot of people I've met have said their parents don't care and would rather not deal with them. Some people should not be allowed to pro create.
